titleEn: Count Ways to Group Overlapping Ranges
title: 统计将重叠区间合并成组的方案数
summary: 把所有区间分到两个组，要求任意两个相交区间必须在同一组，统计合法分组方案数。
insight: 相交关系的每个连通分量必须整体选择一个组。排序后合并所有直接或链式相交的区间即可得到分量数 c，每个分量有两个独立选择，答案为 2^c。
pitfalls: 链式重叠属于同一分量

solutions.title: 合并重叠分量并计算二次幂
solutions.idea: 排序扫描统计互不相交的区间簇。
steps: 若当前起点大于已合并终点，开始新分量
否则扩展当前分量终点

code.java: class Solution { public int countWays(int[][] ranges){Arrays.sort(ranges,Comparator.comparingInt(a->a[0]));int components=0,end=-1;for(int[] range:ranges){if(range[0]>end){components++;end=range[1];}else end=Math.max(end,range[1]);}long answer=1;while(components-->0)answer=answer*2%1_000_000_007;return (int)answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun countWays(ranges:Array<IntArray>):Int{ranges.sortBy{it[0]};var components=0;var end=-1;for(range in ranges){if(range[0]>end){components++;end=range[1]}else end=maxOf(end,range[1])};var answer=1L;repeat(components){answer=answer*2%1_000_000_007};return answer.toInt()} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public:int countWays(vector<vector<int>>& ranges){sort(ranges.begin(),ranges.end());int components=0,end=-1;for(auto& range:ranges){if(range[0]>end){++components;end=range[1];}else end=max(end,range[1]);}long long answer=1;while(components--)answer=answer*2%1'000'000'007;return answer;} };
